The board: see who is working.

Nomi’s chats, background runs and the coding agents it dispatches all sit on this board, with status, folder and resource use. Sessions open in a terminal or IDE show up too, read-only.

The workshop: several coding agents, side by side.

Chat, changes and files in one window. Review the diff before you commit; a project can hold several folders.

Desktop character · optional

She sits in a corner of your desktop and keeps an eye on progress.

A small transparent window that stays on top. Only the character takes clicks; everywhere else your mouse goes straight through. Turn it off if you don't need it — the board and chat work the same.

  • Task status on her faceA thumbs-up when a task is done, an apology when it fails, chin in hand while thinking, typing while tools run.
  • Replies in a bubble firstThe first sentence or two of each reply shows next to her. Click to open the full chat.
  • Drop a file on herDrag a file onto her: a one-line summary in the bubble, the full summary in the chat.
  • Close it any timeOnce closed, notices come through the Dynamic Island or system notifications. Turn her back on in Settings.
